title: **MicroRNome by methylation-dependent sequencing \(mime-seq)**
protocol: Culture _C. elegans_ on solid peptone agar plates seeded with concentrated, streptomycin-resistant E. coli strain HB101.
Harvest L1-stage animals by bleaching protocol after three generations of expansion.
Plate 80,000-90,000 L1s per 15 cm peptone agar plate.
Obtain gravid adults for the next round of bleaching in three days at 20°C.
Harvest 2-5 million L1s by centrifugation and flash freezing in liquid N₂.
Resuspend harvested worms in 600 μl TRizol and proceed to RNA isolation or store at -80°C.
Maintain _Drosophila melanogaster_ fly lines periodically by transferring new adults to fresh media.
Keep flies in an incubator at 25°C with constant humidity.
Set up specific crosses between muscle Gal-4 driver stocks and UAS::Ath-HEN1 stocks.
Transfer control fly lines to fresh medium simultaneously with setup of crosses.
Remove F0 flies from cross-vials after 3 days.
Collect eclosed F1 flies over 3 days and place into fresh vials for aging.
Age the collected F1 flies for 2 days in the new vials.
Sex and genotype the aged F1 flies during collection and placement.
Extract total RNA from S2 cells, flies, and worms using TRIzol Reagent.
Collect 2-5 days old flies for RNA extraction.
Snap-freeze collected flies in liquid N2.
Separate heads from bodies of snap-frozen flies using metal sieves cooled by liquid nitrogen.
Add 1 ml of TRIzol per 20 fly bodies to a tube containing the tissues.
Disrupt fly tissues using pestle tool after adding TRIzol.
Freeze-crack _C. elegans_ L1s previously harvested in 600 μl TRIzol three to four times by freezing and thawing.
Vortex freeze-cracked samples to dissolve cuticle.
Add 200 μl of chloroform per 1 ml of TRIzol to each sample tube.
Agitate the tubes vigorously after adding chloroform.
Centrifuge the tubes at full speed (14,000 rpm) for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase carefully to a fresh tube.
Add 1 volume of acid phenol chloroform (5:1 solution, pH=4.5) to the sample.
Vortex and centrifuge for 3 minutes at full speed at 4°C.
Transfer the upper, aqueous phase to a new tube.
Precipitate RNA by adding 1 μl of glycogen (20 mg/ml) and 1 volume of isopropyl alcohol.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at full speed for at least 30 minutes at 4°C; RNA will form a gel-like pellet on the side and bottom of the tube.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash by adding 300 μl of 80% cold ethanol, vortex and centrifuge for 10 minutes at full speed at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant, collect remaining ethanol by quick centrifugation and pipette all remaining liquid.
Dissolve RNA pellet in 20 μl (or more, depending on the pellet size) of DEPC-treated water to obtain a target RNA concentration above 1 μg/μl.
Prepare a 15% denaturing urea polyacrylamide gel (SequaGel; 20 cm x 16 cm x 1.5 mm).
Pre-run the gel in 0.5x TBE buffer at a constant power of 40-50 W for approximately 30 minutes until the surface temperature of the gel reaches 45–55°C.
Aliquot samples starting from at least 20 μg total RNA in no more than 20 μl volume.
Add an equal volume of gel loading buffer to the aliquoted RNA samples.
Mix 10 pmoles of each 18-mer and 30-mer RNA oligos (2 μl each from a 5 μM stock) with 30 μl of gel loading buffer II to prepare size markers.
Incubate all samples and markers for 4 minutes at 95°C, then spin briefly at room temperature.
Load the denatured samples and markers into wells pre-washed with running buffer.
Run the gel at a constant power of 45-55 W until the bromophenol blue reaches about half way down the gel.
Remove the top glass plate from the gel.
Pour 10-15 ml of SYBR gold in 0.5x TBE onto the gel and stain for 3-4 minutes.
Carefully transfer the stained gel by holding it at the bottom side onto a transparent sheet protector.
Visualize RNA on a UV transilluminator (take a photograph if desired, without exposing longer than necessary).
Cut out small RNAs between 30-mer and 18-mer markers from the gel.
Cut bigger gel pieces into multiple small parts and collect in 1.5 ml LoBind tubes.
Add 800 μl of 0.3 M NaCl + 0.1% SDS to each tube containing gel pieces and allow RNA to elute overnight at room temperature, while rotating.
Precipitate each sample by transferring to two fresh tubes.
Add 1 μl glycogen (20 mg/mL) and 1 ml of 100% ethanol to each tube.
Incubate samples for 1.5-2 hours at -20°C.
Centrifuge samples for 40 minutes at full speed (14000 rpm) at 4°C.
Decant supernatant and wash the pellet with 300 μl of 80% cold ethanol.
Centrifuge again for 10 minutes at 4°C, remove the supernatant completely.
Perform an extra round of centrifugation for 2 minutes.
Pipette out all residual ethanol.
Resuspend the pellet in a final volume of 55 µl DEPC-treated water.
Set up the oxidation reaction for each sample (final volume = 40 μl).
Dissolve 10.69 mg sodium periodate in 1 ml water to prepare fresh sodium periodate solution just before use.
Incubate samples at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Precipitate samples by adding 229 μl of water.
Add 30 μl of 3 M Sodium acetate (pH 5.5) to each tube.
Add 1 μl glycogen and vortex briefly to mix.
Centrifuge briefly to collect the solution on the bottom of the tube.
Add 900 μl of 100% ethanol to each tube.
Vortex briefly to mix again.
Incubate for 1.5-2 hours at -20°C.
Centrifuge for 40 minutes at full speed (14,000 rpm) at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant and wash the pellet with 300 μl of 80% cold ethanol.
Centrifuge again for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Perform an extra round of centrifugation for 2 minutes.
Pipette out all residual ethanol.
Resuspend the pellet in a final volume of 6 μl DEPC-treated water without air-drying.
Samples are ready for the 3' ligation step.
Prepare the master mix as specified.
Add 4 μl of master mix to each 6 μl sample, mix and spin.
Add 10 μl of PEG (8000) 50% to each sample.
Incubate on ice in the cold room overnight.
Prepare two 15% denaturing urea polyacrylamide gels per sample.
Add 20 µl of gel loading buffer II to the ligated samples.
For markers, add 40 µl of gel loading buffer II and load half (30 µl) per gel.
Pre-run the gel and denature samples at 95ºC.
Gently load the samples into pre-washed wells.
Run the gel until the bromophenol blue reaches the end.
Stain the gel as previously described.
Cut the area between the ligated 18- and 30-mer markers to size select small RNAs.
Elute RNA overnight in 800 µl of 0.3 M NaCl + 0.1% SDS at room temperature while rotating.
Precipitate each sample by transferring to two fresh tubes without gel pieces, adding 400 µl aliquot with 1 µl glycogen and 1 ml of 100% ethanol; incubate for 1.5-2 hours at -20˚C.
Centrifuge samples for 40 minutes at full speed (14,000 rpm) at 4˚C; decant supernatant and wash the pellet with 300 µl of cold 80% ethanol.
Remove all supernatant after centrifuging again for 10 minutes at 4˚C and perform an extra round of centrifugation for 2 minutes to remove residual ethanol.
Resuspend the pellet in a final volume of 7.5 μl DEPC-treated water.
Prepare the master mix as described in Table 3 for one sample.
Add 7.5 μl of master mix to each sample, mix and spin.
Add 5 μl of PEG (8000) 50% to a final volume of 20 μl per sample.
Incubate the samples on ice overnight in the cold room.
Prepare 10% denaturing urea polyacrylamide gels for size selection of small RNAs.
Pre-run the gel in 0.5x TBE buffer at constant power of 40 W until surface temperature reaches 45–55°C.
Mix 1 μl (10 pmol) of the 60-mer, in vitro transcribed marker with 0.5 μl of Century RNA Marker in 20 μl of gel loading buffer II for one gel.
Gently load samples into pre-washed wells after denaturation at 95°C.
Run the gel until bromophenol blue reaches the end of the gel.
Stain the gel as previously described.
Cut the gel above the 60-mer band and below the lowest Century marker band (100 nt) to size select 3'- and 5'-ligated small RNAs.
Elute RNA overnight in 800 µl 0.3 M NaCl + 0.1% SDS at room temperature while rotating.
Transfer each sample to two fresh tubes without transferring gel pieces.
Add 400 µl aliquot, 1 µl glycogen (20 mg/mL), and 1 ml of 100% ethanol to each sample.
Incubate samples for 1.5-2 hours at -20°C.
Centrifuge 40 minutes at full speed (14,000 rpm) at 4°C.
Decant supernatant after centrifugation and wash the pellet with 300 µl of 80% cold ethanol.
Incubate again for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant completely after incubating.
Perform an extra round of centrifugation for 2 minutes to remove residual ethanol.
Without air-drying, resuspend the pellet in a final volume of 17 µl DEPC-treated water.
Samples are ready for the Reverse Transcription reaction.
Add 1 μl (100 μM) small RNA seq RT primer to each sample (17 µl 5´ ligation product).
Incubate at 72°C for 2 minutes.
Spin at 20,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Cool on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 18 µl of RT mix to each sample, resulting in a total reaction volume of 36 µl.
Split the mixture into two tubes (18 µl each) to create the “+RT” and “-RT” control tubes.
For the “+RT” tube, add 2 µl Superscript III reverse transcriptase.
For the “-RT” tube, add 2 µl water.
Incubate each tube at 50°C for 1 hour.
Heat inactivate RT enzyme by incubating at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Store samples at -20°C until qPCR amplification step.
To amplify cDNA libraries, use the KAPA Real Time Library Amplification Kit.
Mix 10 µl of each RT reaction (half of the volume) with 1 μl of 25 µM TruSeq Index reverse primer (Solexa_IDX_rev).
Assign a unique barcode to each sample for multiplexing.
Set up a master mix, adding 25 µl of 2x KAPA HiFi HS RM last and mixing gently.
Add 39 µl to each sample to achieve a final volume of 50 µl, then mix and collect by centrifugation.
Prepare tubes with 50 µl of each fluorescent standard (standards 3 and 4) in triplicate.
Run the qPCR program until samples reach the fluorescence level of standards 3-4.
Pause the program during the 10 sec step when a sample reaches between standards 3 and 4, close to standard 4, and remove respective tubes from the PCR machine.
Continue cycling until all samples have reached the desired amount.
Prepare a 2% Low-Range Ultra agarose gel according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Swirl the flask often during heating procedure.
Add 1x SYBR safe to the gel.
Load 6 µl of GeneRuler 50 bp DNA Ladder into the gel.
Mix amplified cDNA with 10 µl of Orange G loading dye 6x (total volume 60 µl).
Run the gel at constant 80-100 V until the Orange G loading dye band is at 3/4 of the gel length.
Visualize the gel on a long wave UV transilluminator.
Excise the DNA band between 150-200 bp with a clean scalpel or razor blade and place in a clean tube.
Avoid cutting into the strong lower band of ~120 bp, which corresponds to adaptor dimers.
Add 3 volumes (~800-900 µl) of ADB buffer (Zymoclean™ Gel DNA Recovery Kit) to dissolve the gel.
Incubate samples at 55ºC for 10 minutes or until the gel slice is completely dissolved.
Mix and collect by centrifugation.
Transfer the melted agarose solution to a Zymo-Spin™ Column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge 1 minute at 10,000 rpm and discard the flow-through.
Add 200 µl of DNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge 1 minute and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Add 15-20 μl of water directly to the column matrix.
Place the column into a 1.5 ml tube and centrifuge for 1 minute to elute DNA.
Purified DNA is now ready for quality control and deep sequencing.
